$description: ketch for macOS design tokens (W3C DTCG 2025.10). The single source: Tokens.swift, tokens.css and the DESIGN.md front matter are generated from this file by build.mjs.

accent.$description: Blue: the one accent. Fills carry accent.on; text and glyphs on glass use accent.ink. The user can pick another accent in Settings -> Appearance; these are the defaults.

default.$description: Fills: primary buttons, selection, progress, counts. #0a84ff deepened just enough for 4.5:1 under white labels.

subtle.$description: Accent wash behind selected rows, tinted buttons and the update pill (--g-accent-soft).

on.$description: Text and glyphs on an accent fill (--g-on-accent).

ink.$description: Accent as text or a glyph on glass: links, the selected sidebar symbol, tinted button labels (--g-accent-ink).

tertiary.$description: Captions and metadata only; never body copy.

warning.$description: A doctor finding that should be looked at.

error.$description: Failed operation or a broken install.

background.$description: The canvas under the glass: a base, and the backdrop wash (the Ocean wallpaper of the mock) drawn over it at opacity.wash. Dark mode deepens the wash so light ink keeps its contrast.

base.$description: The window's own colour under the wash.

washHill.$description: The near hill along the bottom of the wash.

washDeep.$description: The far hill, lowest in the wash.

glass.$description: Tints standing in for the system materials in preview.html and in the contrast check. Natively, Liquid Glass and the standard materials render themselves; only the solid fallbacks are painted as colours.

window.$description: The window pane in the preview and the menu-bar strip (--g-glass). Natively the window is opaque: canvas plus wash.

regular.$description: Liquid Glass (glossy): sidebar, toolbar groups, the floating activity bar (--g-glass-hi).

frost.$description: Content-layer cards: package rows, the detail panels, findings, settings groups (--g-glass-lo).

control.$description: Raised controls on glass: the selected sidebar item, the search field, secondary buttons, chips, the segmented thumb (--g-glass-top).

clear.$description: Glass.clear, when Settings -> Appearance picks it: small controls only, never body text.

shade.$description: Inner shade along the bottom rim, inset (--g-rim-lo).

solidRegular.$description: Reduce Transparency: replaces glass.window, glass.regular and glass.frost.

solidElevated.$description: Reduce Transparency: replaces glass.control and glass.elevated.

shadow.$description: Shadow colours for depth on custom surfaces; elevation.* uses them.

drop.$description: Tight lift under controls, rows and the selected item (--g-drop).

window.$description: The deep shadow under the window and popovers (--g-shadow).

scrim.$description: Dims the window behind a sheet (--g-scrim).

control.$description: Resting fill of secondary controls and search field.

focusRing.$description: Keyboard focus ring: accent.ink, 3:1 against glass.

preset.$description: The swatches Settings -> Appearance offers. Single values: the user's pick is the same colour in every appearance.

tint.$description: Window glass tints (Glass.tint). Clear, the default, is no tint.

accent.$description: Accent presets. System, the default, follows the macOS accent colour.

space.$description: 4-point scale. Layout uses these, never literals.

xs.$description: Badges' inner glyph wells, focus ring offsets.

lg.$description: Cards, forms, the detail panels, the activity bar.

xl.$description: The window, sheets, popovers, the menu-bar extra.

blur.$description: Backdrop blur for the CSS preview. Native glass ignores these.

opacity.$description: Opacities that are settings, not colours.

wash.$description: Default strength of the backdrop wash over the canvas base (Settings -> Appearance).

washMax.$description: The strongest wash the setting allows; the contrast check composites at this strength.

tint.$description: How strongly a tint preset colours the glass in light mode: the opacity of the colour passed to Glass.tint(_:).

tintDark.$description: The same in dark mode, where a tint reads stronger.

display.$description: Large title: the Discover hero, the package name in the detail header.

headline.$description: Package name in a row, button labels, field labels.

caption.$description: Metadata, timestamps, notes under a field.

badge.$description: Counts and short status words in a capsule.

elevation.$description: Depth levels. Each is outer shadows (key + ambient) plus inset highlight and shade: the 3D rim.

lift.$description: Liquid glass lens: a specular rim, a soft inner shade and a tight drop. Rows, selected items, raised controls.

window.$description: The window and popovers in the preview; macOS draws the real window shadow.

motion.$description: Durations and curves. Under Reduce Motion every transition becomes a cross-fade of motion.instant.

gentle.$description: Sheets and the menu-bar popover arriving.

emphasized.$description: A finished install settling in: slight overshoot.
